title: Chowchilla School Bus Kidnapping

scenes.text: 26 children vanished from a school bus in 1976

scenes.text: The kidnapping took place near Chowchilla, California, USA
Kidnappers demanded $5 million ransom, never paid
Police discovered the bus hidden in a culvert after a massive search
